paragraphs: Two sprout-related outbreaks have ended [1][2]. A Salmonella outbreak linked to broccoli sprouts affected 34 people across 6 states with 3 hospitalizations [1]. A separate outbreak involving E. coli and Salmonella in alfalfa sprouts was larger, sickening 77 people across 16 states with 6 hospitalizations [2]. Neither outbreak resulted in deaths [1][2].

Check your freezer for Betterballen brand "Bami Rolls" with "BEST BY" October 2027 and lot codes BR-2026-01 or BR-2026-02 [3]. These products contain undeclared sesame allergen and have been recalled [3][19]. If you have them, do not eat them [3]. The affected products were sold in Georgia and South Carolina [3].

Fresh & Ready Foods LLC is recalling 2,414 Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches (4.6 oz) due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination [4]. Do not eat these products [4]. Brad's Raw Chips is recalling certain Brad's Plant Based Crunchy Kale (2 oz) and Brad's Veggie Chips Kale (3 oz) products because they may contain thallium [6].
